response: Human perivascular adipose tissue (pWAT) has chemotactic properties through the secretion of different chemokines. Research suggests that pWAT might contribute to the progression of obesity-associated atherosclerosis, indicating a potential role in the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis. This implies that the production of chemokines by perivascular adipose tissue could be a factor in the development and progression of atherosclerosis, particularly in individuals with obesity.
